_broad_pattern_rationale: Why some patterns below are broad rather than narrow (SP-CCE-05 P5.2):
Bash(find:*)        — autonomous chain runs walk plans/, .claude/, clients/
Bash(grep:*)        — shell grep is used by chain-state.sh and a few hooks
hooks. The Grep tool is preferred for content search,
but shell grep stays for hook-internal predicates.
Bash(npm install:*) — chain runs occasionally install one-shot deps (e.g.
scripts that pull a missing package). Narrowing to
named packages would force a settings.local.json edit
per dep — high churn, low security gain on local-only.
Bash(rm -f *)       — hook + chain workflows clean tmp marker files. Bounded
to specific paths in code; broad allow is convenience.
These live in settings.local.json (uncommitted), NOT settings.json. They
apply only to this developer's machine. Note: Bash(env) is NOT in this file
